Eight sections that protect your files from day one — tap a section to mark it read
Security guide complete — your files are in safe hands
Eight sections that protect your files from day one
Turn on the Vault with a strong PIN
The Vault encrypts sensitive files with AES-256-GCM backed by hardware Keystore keys. Choose 6 or more unexpected digits — never reuse your phone unlock code.
Understand encryption before you need it
Vault folders derive HKDF keys from your PIN plus a hardware key, and cloud credentials stay in a local AES/GCM vault. No key ever leaves your device.
Store your recovery phrase away from the device
The 12-word BIP39 phrase is your only way back if the PIN is forgotten. Write it on paper and keep it safe — never photograph or message it.
Share over the network with strong credentials

The built-in FTP and WebDAV servers are password-protected by default. Change the nova/nova defaults immediately, keep scheduled sync on Wi-Fi only, and accept the TOFU host fingerprint on first connect.
Connect cloud accounts with least privilege
OAuth with PKCE grants file-scoped access only. Review linked connections in your provider settings periodically and revoke what you no longer use.
NovaFiles asks for all-files access to manage your whole storage — nothing more. No network without your action, no tracking, no usage stats sent anywhere.
Use secure wipe for sensitive files
Ordinary deletion can be undone by recovery tools. Secure wipe overwrites the file data before removing it from the .NovaFilesTrash bin — use it for official documents and private photos.
Update from the official source only
NovaFiles is 100% open source — builds are reproducible and the APK hash can be verified before install. Update from F-Droid or GitHub Releases only.
An open-source file manager with pro power: encrypted vault, unified cloud, archives in every format, a built-in terminal, and 100% on-device intelligence — no ads, no tracking.

NovaFiles will ask for the "All files" permission to manage your entire storage: transfer, cleanup and instant indexing. Everything stays on your device — nothing goes online without your explicit action.
Hide sensitive files in an AES-256 encrypted vault unlocked by your fingerprint or a PIN, and back up your BIP39 recovery phrase. Read the eight-section security guide from Settings afterwards.
A smart layer that respects privacy
Download classification, storage-full forecasts, and maintenance suggestions explained by reason and expected savings — deterministic rules on your device, switchable off in Settings.

Grant the “all files” permission once and reach every path on your device: multi-select with a long press and drag & drop between two iPad-style panes, with list, grid, or dual-pane views and flexible sorting.
NovaFiles indexes your entire storage instantly so results appear as you type, with type, size, and date filters to narrow them. Add colored tags to files and gather them later with one tap.
Create ZIP with AES passwords, 7z and TAR at any compression level, extract 7z, RAR, and TAR safely with a Zip-Slip guard, and split large files into volumes of a size you choose.

Connect to SMB, SFTP, FTP, and WebDAV shares with TOFU protection on first contact, and run an FTP or WebDAV server from your device to share files without cables — with a connection log and a QR code for every session.
Link Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive with secure authentication, and schedule sync pairs between any two local or cloud folders, with exact-once camera sync that never copies a file twice.
Hide sensitive files in an AES-256 encrypted vault with HKDF encrypted folders, a 12-word BIP39 recovery phrase, and a calculator disguise — so nothing is seen that should not be.

The Treemap analyzer shows where your space goes, and the smart engine suggests explainable maintenance: duplicates, bloated caches, and abandoned files — every suggestion shows its reason and expected savings, and the decision is always yours.

Create rules that watch a folder and act automatically: move, archive, shrink images, tag, upload to cloud, or run a sync pair — try them in dry-run mode first and review the execution log with safe undo.
A text editor with Markdown, syntax coloring, and huge-file support, a built-in audio/video player and PDF viewer, one-tap batch image convert and shrink, and a pure shell with full file commands.
Export your preferences and bookmarks into a nova-settings.json file and move it to another device — no cloud and no server passwords, with a checksum that detects any external tampering.
Ten short chapters explaining every feature — with live search and progress tracking
